installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Downloads the prebuilt twitch-miner binary from GitHub releases
set -e
cd /mnt/server

case "$(uname -m)" in
  x86_64) ARCH=x86_64 ;;
  aarch64|arm64) ARCH=aarch64 ;;
  *) echo "Unsupported architecture: $(uname -m)"; exit 1 ;;
esac

REPO="wildesPepega/twitch-miner-rs"
if [ -z "${VERSION}" ] || [ "${VERSION}" = "latest" ]; then
  URL="https://github.com/${REPO}/releases/latest/download/twitch-miner-linux-${ARCH}"
else
  URL="https://github.com/${REPO}/releases/download/${VERSION}/twitch-miner-linux-${ARCH}"
fi

echo "Downloading ${URL}"
curl -fsSL -o twitch-miner "${URL}"
chmod +x twitch-miner
echo "Installation complete"
